our_interpretation: Completion of the proposed corporate restructuring counts; announcing an intention does not.
I allow through April 30, 2025 for 'six or so months'. The wording supplies no exact final day.
I count conversion of the operating business to a public benefit corporation as qualifying, without requiring dissolution of the nonprofit parent.
criteria.support_condition: Public corporate records establish completion of the qualifying restructuring by April 30, 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated corporate records establish that the restructuring remained incomplete after April 2025 or was completed substantially later.
